meta.name: google-ads
meta.description: Manage Google Ads — performance, keywords, bids, budgets, negatives, campaigns, ads, search terms, QS, location targeting, bulk operations, experiments, asset management, portfolio bidding, offline conversions. Use for any mention of Google Ads, CPA, ROAS, ad spend, or campaign settings.

copy.tagline: 管理谷歌广告投放与优化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责谷歌广告账户的日常管理与效果提升。
copy.tagline_en: Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Google Ads accounts and want to improve performance.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你管理 Google Ads 账户：查看广告效果、调整关键词出价和预算、暂停或启用广告系列、添加否定关键词、创建实验等。它会先分析数据，再执行操作，并记录每次改动以便回退。
howto.when: 当你提到 Google Ads、广告系列、关键词、出价、预算、CPA、ROAS、搜索词、否定关键词、广告效果、地理位置定位、实验等话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看上周的广告系列效果怎么样？
say.note: Claude 会查询并总结广告系列的关键指标。

say.text: 把“运动鞋”这个关键词的出价提高到 2 元。
say.note: Claude 会执行出价更新并返回变更 ID。

say.text: 给“夏季促销”广告系列添加否定关键词“免费”。
say.note: Claude 会创建否定关键词列表并关联到广告系列。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage Google Ads accounts: view ad performance, adjust keyword bids and budgets, pause or enable campaigns, add negative keywords, create experiments, etc. It first analyzes data, then executes actions, and records each change for rollback.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Google Ads, campaigns, keywords, bids, budgets, CPA, ROAS, search terms, negative keywords, ad performance, location targeting, experiments, etc.

say_en.text: Show me last week's campaign performance.
say_en.note: Claude will query and summarize key metrics.

say_en.text: Increase the bid for 'running shoes' to $2.
say_en.note: Claude will update the bid and return a change ID.

say_en.text: Add 'free' as a negative keyword to the 'Summer Sale' campaign.
say_en.note: Claude will create a negative keyword list and link it.
